cards.title: Parents: Balance Work and Childcare This Summer
cards.body: With holiday childcare costs rising, many parents struggle to juggle work and school-aged children during summer breaks. The Guardian is seeking reader experiences on managing this annual challenge.

cards.title: I Ghosted a Problematic Friend. Now I Feel Terrible
cards.body: Ask Annalisa Barbieri explores ending a friendship that made you feel on edge. Prioritizing your own wellbeing is the right choice even when it brings mixed emotions.

cards.title: Money Talks: Easing Household Tension After Divorce
cards.body: Family law attorneys and divorced parents share guidance on discussing finances with children after divorce. Building stability at home requires managing money conversations thoughtfully.

cards.title: Why Losing a Child Shatters Your World
cards.body: The death of a child wounds six core psychological needs simultaneously. Healing requires preserving grief while slowly rebuilding safety, agency, and meaning.

cards.title: Adult Children Blame: How to Respond Constructively
cards.body: When adult children say "you ruined my life," your first reaction determines whether relationships worsen or heal. Understanding this dynamic is crucial for moving forward.

cards.title: Building Support When You're Estranged From Family
cards.body: Estrangement from family creates quiet, hard moments few prepare you for. Five practical strategies help build the emotional support network you're missing.

cards.title: Why Someone Else's Anxiety Makes Us Anxious
cards.body: When loved ones are anxious, we often absorb their stress too. Anxiety therapy helps parents and caregivers stay grounded while supporting others.

cards.title: Heatwave Anxiety: Managing Kids' Mental Health
cards.body: Extreme heat affects mental wellbeing, with young people particularly vulnerable. Parents can help children manage heatwave-related anxiety with practical coping strategies.

cards.title: Sisters Discover They Were Best Friends All Along
cards.body: Andrea Urmston knew she had an adopted brother, only to discover he was already her closest friend. Their remarkable connection deepened after learning the truth.
